## Problem and change

Describe the concrete problem, resulting behaviour and related issue (if any).

## Validation

List exact checks and environment, plus failures, skips and untested paths. Include screenshots for UI changes and measured evidence for performance/audio claims. Do not upload private or copyrighted media, credentials or unredacted logs.

## Risk and recovery

Explain dependency/API changes, saved-data effects and how to undo or recover from the change. Say whether new software, models, network access or paid services are required.

- [ ] The change is focused and preserves existing work/output on failure.
- [ ] Relevant checks were run, or the reason they could not run is recorded.
- [ ] Documentation and source inventory were updated where needed.
- [ ] Third-party licences/notices and secret/media exclusions were checked.
- [ ] AI assistance, if used, was disclosed and its output reviewed.

Security vulnerabilities belong in private reporting under SECURITY.md, not in a public reproduction here.
